mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, account_id, flinks_transaction_id, amount, merchant, description, mcc, category, transaction_date, card_used_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{flinksTransactionId}, #{amount}, #{merchant}, #{description}, #{mcc}, #{category}, #{transactionDate}, #{cardUsedId})

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, account_id, flinks_transaction_id, amount, merchant, description, mcc, category, transaction_date) VALUES
(#{t.userId}, #{t.accountId}, #{t.flinksTransactionId}, #{t.amount}, #{t.merchant}, #{t.description}, #{t.mcc}, #{t.category}, #{t.transactionDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET best_card_id = #{bestCardId}, actual_cashback = #{actualCashback}, optimal_cashback = #{optimalCashback}, missed_cashback = #{missedCashback}, is_analyzed = #{isAnalyzed}, category = #{category} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE transactions SET is_analyzed = false, best_card_id = NULL, actual_cashback = NULL, optimal_cashback = NULL, missed_cashback = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_analyzed = false
SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND flinks_transaction_id = #{flinksId}
SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total_amount, SUM(missed_cashback) as total_missed FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_date >= #{startDate} GROUP BY category
